formal_boundary.conditional_selector: A fixed physical controller, reachable preparation/resource class, readout, and horizon compile an action envelope and therefore a response quotient.
formal_boundary.monotonicity: Enlarging the admitted physical controller resources enlarges the action envelope and can strictly refine response classes.
formal_boundary.nonselection: The drift/source law, processor alone, and one actual program history do not determine the counterfactual preparation class.

non_claims: not a new quantum-control or programmable-processor theorem
not a selected observer, controller, preparation class, or archive in nature
not a universal impossibility of deriving counterfactual tasks from physics
not a record ontology, physical remainder, prediction, law, or new physics
